title: Sutra AI Risk & Compliance Questionnaire
description: Multi-dimensional governance questionnaire aligned with MeitY India AI Guidelines, DPDP Act 2023, RBI FREE-AI Framework, and EU AI Act.

categories.name: Prohibited Practices & Red Lines
categories.description: Assessment of absolute legal and ethical prohibitions under EU AI Act Article 5 and MeitY Safety Sutras.

questions.label: Does the system perform social scoring or evaluation of individuals based on personal characteristics leading to detrimental or disproportionate treatment?
questions.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(c); MeitY Sutra 1 (Safety & Trust)

questions.label: Is the system deployed for real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces?
questions.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(d); DPDP Act 2023 Sec. 9

questions.label: Does the system deploy subliminal or intentionally manipulative techniques to distort human behavior causing psychological or physical harm?
questions.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(a); MeitY Sutra 1

questions.label: Does the system exploit vulnerabilities of specific groups due to age, disability, or socio-economic status to distort behavior?
questions.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(b); MeitY Sutra 5 (Inclusivity)

categories.name: Data Sensitivity & Privacy
categories.description: Personal and sensitive data processing profile under DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025.

questions.label: Does the AI system ingest, process, or generate personal data of individuals?
Select all sensitive data categories handled by the model:
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023 Sec. 9; RBI FREE-AI Data Governance

questions.label: What is the expected scale of individuals whose data is processed?

option_labels.high: More than 1,000,000 individuals (Significant Data Fiduciary threshold)

questions.label: Does the system process personal data of children (below 18 years) or provide services directly targeted to children?
questions.legal_basis: DPDP Act 2023 Sec. 9(1), 9(2) (Absolute bar on behavioral tracking)

categories.name: Deployment Context & Criticality
categories.description: Sectoral placement and public interaction scope under MeitY and RBI directives.

questions.label: Is the system directly exposed to external customers, users, or the general public?
Which primary industry or domain is the system deployed in?

option_labels.critical_infrastructure: Energy, Transport, Water, or Telecom Infrastructure

questions.legal_basis: RBI FREE-AI Framework; MeitY Critical AI Systems

categories.name: Autonomy & Decision Impact
categories.description: Degree of automation and potential for material harm or legal/financial effects.

questions.label: What degree of decision-making authority does the model possess?

option_labels.advisory_with_human_in_loop: Advisory / Assistive with mandatory human review before action
option_labels.automated_operational: Automated operational tasks with low individual impact
option_labels.automated_legal_or_financial_effect: Fully automated decisions producing legal or significant financial impact (e.g., credit denial, employment, insurance)

questions.legal_basis: RBI FREE-AI Principle: Explainability & Human Agency; EU AI Act Art. 14

questions.label: Is there a real-time, functioning human override mechanism for all model recommendations?
Can the model autonomously execute financial transactions, alter user balances, or modify external system states without human approval?

categories.name: Synthetic Content & Provenance
categories.description: Obligations under IT (Intermediary Guidelines) Amendment Rules 2026 for synthetic media.

questions.label: Does the system generate synthetic text, audio, images, or video representations?
Is the generated synthetic media disseminated to the general public or open social platforms?
Are automated metadata tags and persistent digital watermarks embedded into all generated synthetic content?

categories.name: European Union Cross-Exposure
categories.description: Extraterritorial application of EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689).

questions.label: Is the model or service offered to users located in the European Union, or does its output affect EU persons?
Does the application fall into an EU AI Act Annex III High-Risk domain (e.g. credit scoring, biometric categorization, HR/recruitment, essential services, education scoring)?
questions.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 6 & Annex III
